title: UK single release: Junior’s Farm by Paul McCartney and Wings | 1974
content:
Paul McCartney and Wings’ single ‘Junior’s Farm’ was released in the United Kingdom on 25 October 1974, with ‘Sally G’ on the b-side.

The single peaked at number 16 on the UK singles chart

‘Junior’s Farm’ was released on 4 November 1974 in the USA, where it reached number three on the US Billboard Hot 100, and four on the Cash Box Top 100.

The single was also a top 10 hit in Canada, New Zealand, Norway, and South Africa.
